plan.title: test(session): CODEX_CI leaks host identity into session, occupancy, and swarm suites

narratives.Description: Hermetic identity for omit-env session/occupancy/swarm tests. Bound lean 5705215585.
narratives.Overview:
## Defect

Running the full TypeScript check lane from a Codex host with ambient `CODEX_CI` produces 52 session/occupancy/swarm failures outside the four doctor failures already tracked by #3770. The same representative tests pass with only `CODEX_CI` removed.

This is a broader recurrence of the ambient-environment fixture leak fixed for `DEFT_SESSION_ID` in #3877.

## Evidence

Observed at PR #4634 head `cc7fb4a2ad02fd633babd06b9880aad2d7bd7fc6`:

- `task check`: 56 failures in 16 files.
- Four `packages/core/src/doctor/session-coda.test.ts` failures match #3770.
- The other 52 failures span session-start, occupancy, session-ritual, and swarm tests.
- Control run with `CODEX_CI` unset: 3 representative files, 89 tests, all passed.

Control command:

```sh
env -u CODEX_CI pnpm exec vitest run \
  packages/core/src/session/session-start.test.ts \
  packages/cli/src/occupancy-steal.test.ts \
  packages/core/src/swarm/swarm-deep-coverage.test.ts \
  --coverage.enabled=false
```

## Root cause

`CODEX_CI` declares a payload-identity host. Direct unit calls to `runSessionStart` commonly omit an injected `env` bag and an explicit session id, so production code falls through to ambient `process.env`. The declared Codex host cannot read a hook-payload session id in these direct tests and correctly refuses to mint one. The production fail-closed behavior is working; the fixtures are not hermetic.

`packages/core/src/ts-check-lane/run-lane.ts` removes `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` but preserves host/session markers, so the full lane exposes this leak on a real Codex host.

## Expected

- Session, occupancy, ritual, and swarm unit tests inject a hermetic env/session identity where their subject is not host detection.
- Explicit host-detection tests continue to cover `CODEX_CI`.
- Production declared-host and refuse-mint behavior remains unchanged.
- The full TypeScript check lane has the same result with or without ambient `CODEX_CI`.

## Boundaries

This is test isolation. Do not weaken host identity detection, declared-host refusal, or mint policy to make the suite green.

Refs #3877, #3770, #4634.

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-16T17:18:36Z)

model: grok-4
role: critic

Open critique of #4636 at dispatch-sha `3be4b339705132fe8c9d1f1b7a8c08425b255ee2`. Ceiling comment 5701381670. P1 is fixture isolation, not a production identity recut.

## 1. Isolate the declared-host presence surface, not `CODEX_CI` alone
blocks-the-design

Evidence: `detectDeclaredIdentityHosts` reads `DECLARED_IDENTITY_HOST_PRESENCE` (`packages/core/src/session/host-session-owner.ts`). Codex is `CODEX_SANDBOX`, `CODEX_CI`, `OPENAI_CODEX`; any non-empty member is enough. `resolveOccupancySessionClaim` then refuse-mints (`packages/core/src/session/occupancy.ts`). Re-verified at dest: Codex-only `CODEX_CI=1` with Grok owner unset, `pnpm exec vitest run` on the issue's control files. `occupancy-steal` "refuses steal without --confirm" expected exit 2, got 1, stderr `occupancy refuses to mint an owner on host codex`. `session-start.test.ts` 19 failures, all `expected 1 to be 0` on calls with no `env` and no `sessionId`. Same steal file was green when this Grok host still published `GROK_SESSION_ID` beside `CODEX_CI`.

Failure mode: a `CODEX_CI`-only stub, `delete`, or `env -u` leaves `CODEX_SANDBOX` / `OPENAI_CODEX` (same Codex row) and the rest of the presence table. Suite stays red on a real Codex host that sets a sibling marker, and on Cursor/Claude/Grok hosts the same omit-env tests refuse-mint or bind a host owner. That is the #3877 recurrence: one ambient key, then the next.

Disposition: P1 cannot bind as a one-key scrub. Bind it to hermetic identity for `detectDeclaredIdentityHosts` (constructed `env` / explicit `sessionId`), and keep production presence detection unchanged.

## 2. Two seams, and the exported hermetic list is the wrong one
sharpens-framing

Evidence: library calls take `input.env ?? process.env`. `session-start.test.ts` `baseOptions` omits both `env` and `sessionId` (41 `runSessionStart` calls, 5 `env: {}`). `swarmLaunch` always claims occupancy with `env: args.environ ?? process.env` (`packages/core/src/swarm/launch.ts`); deep-coverage launch tests omit both. CLI occupancy `run()` hard-wires `env: process.env` (`occupancy-steal.ts` and grant/release/heartbeat). Grant/release/heartbeat already scrub `HOST_ENV_IDENTITY_VARIABLES` per #3954; that export is only `GROK_SESSION_ID`. Presence markers are a different table and are not exported. Steal tests do not even scrub that list.

Failure mode: "inject hermetic env" read as `options.env` never reaches steal. "Use the existing hermetic surface" read as `HOST_ENV_IDENTITY_VARIABLES` deletes the Grok owner and leaves `GROK_AGENT` / `CODEX_CI`, which is refuse-mint. Lane poison of `CODEX_CI` does not fix the issue's own control (`pnpm exec vitest run`, not `sanitizeTsLaneEnv`).

Disposition: name both seams on the bound P1. Library/swarm: replacement bag or explicit `sessionId` on the existing helpers (`baseOptions`, `swarmLaunch` args, #3877 `env: {}`). CLI: explicit `--session-id` where the subject is not host detection, or a process.env scrub that includes presence markers and restores them. Do not treat `HOST_ENV_IDENTITY_VARIABLES` as sufficient.

## 3. Host-detection coverage of `CODEX_CI` does not exist yet
sharpens-framing

Evidence: `occupancy-mint-refusal.test.ts` stayed 23/23 green under ambient `CODEX_CI` because those tests already inject bags. `detectDeclaredIdentityHosts` assertions name `CLAUDECODE` and `GROK_AGENT` only. No Codex marker appears in that file. `git grep CODEX_CI` at dest is the presence table plus `AUTHZ_AGENT_SHELL_ENV_MARKERS`.

Failure mode: "explicit host-detection tests continue to cover `CODEX_CI`" describes a control that is not there. A fixture sweep can green the suite with zero Codex-positive refuse-mint case, and a later presence-table edit can drop Codex without a red test.

Disposition: add a Codex-positive refuse-mint / `detectDeclaredIdentityHosts({ CODEX_CI: "1" })` case in that existing file. Do not weaken detection to make omit-env tests pass.

## Injection / swarm lens

This target changes occupancy identity and shared test env.

Payload Codex has no host-env owner, so presence without `--session-id` is refuse-mint. That production control is working: mint-refusal tests stayed green. Unit tests whose subject is USER.md, `--confirm`, ceremony dial, or swarm manifest are not host-detection tests; they currently exercise the last-resort mint path by omitting identity, and on a declared Codex host that path is denied. Dual-host is a fixture lie: Grok owner plus `CODEX_CI` masked steal until Grok was unset.

Swarm is the same claim, not a backend-probe effect. `probeSubagentBackends` does not read `CODEX_CI`. `swarmLaunch` occupancy with omitted `environ` is the leak. Spreading `process.env` into a "hermetic" bag reimports the marker. `vi.stubEnv` / delete-without-restore of presence keys is shared process state and will flake host-detection tests in the same worker.

## Inventory and roads not taken

Existing mechanisms, in order: #3877 empty replacement bag (`env: {}`) in occupancy and session-start-rearm mint-path tests; #3494 constructed environ, not `process.env` minus a denylist (`routing-set-openclaw.test.ts`, denylist rotted on `CLAUDECODE` then `DEFT_AGENT_RUNTIME`); #3954 CLI scrub of `HOST_ENV_IDENTITY_VARIABLES` (too narrow here); #4506 lane keeps occupancy / `DEFT_SESSION_ID` and only poisons scope/bypass keys.

Road not taken: add `CODEX_CI` to `TS_LANE_POISON_ENV_KEYS`. Steelman: one line would make `task check` look invariant on Codex. What flips it: the measured reproduction is direct vitest; lane strip leaves `pnpm exec vitest run` red; it blinds any host-detection test that still reads `process.env`; it fights #4506.

Do not spread `process.env`. Do not mint by deleting declared-host detection.

## 4. Count pin and #3770 boundary
footnote

The issue's 52 / 16 files is at PR #4634 head `cc7fb4a2`, not dest. Dest re-verify of the three control files: steal 1 failed, session-start 19 failed, mint-refusal 23 passed. `session-coda.test.ts` has no `CODEX_CI`; #3770 stays out.

## Injection / swarm lens

Target changes occupancy identity and shared test env. Payload Codex has no host-env owner, so presence without sessionId is refuse-mint. That production control is working: mint-refusal tests inject bags and do not exercise omit-env. Unit tests whose subject is --confirm, ceremony, or swarm manifest currently exercise last-resort mint by omitting identity.

Swarm is the same claim. swarmLaunch occupancy with omitted environ is the leak. Spreading process.env into a hermetic bag reimports the marker. vi.stubEnv / delete-without-restore of presence keys is shared process state.

Existing mechanisms: #3877 empty replacement bag; #3494 constructed environ, not process.env minus a denylist; #3954 CLI scrub of HOST_ENV_IDENTITY_VARIABLES (too narrow here); #4506 lane keeps occupancy / DEFT_SESSION_ID.
